title: 8-Day Wilpattu to Coast with 4 STAR Hotels & Private Transport
seoTitle: 8-Day Wilpattu to Coast with 4 STAR Hotels & Private Transport | Hai Sri Lanka
metaDescription: Private 8-day Sri Lanka tour: Wilpattu safari, Sigiriya, Kaudulla elephants, Kandy, Ella hills, Mirissa, Galle Fort, and south-coast beaches.
shortDescription: Wilpattu to the south coast in eight days - wildlife, culture, and beach with 4 STAR stays and private transport.
overview:
An eight-day private journey starting in Wilpattu's wild lakes — a quieter safari landscape famous for leopards and rich biodiversity — then into Sigiriya, Habarana village life, Kaudulla elephants, and Ayurveda downtime.
Continue to Kandy's sacred temple and cultural show, climb through Ambuluwawa and tea country to Ella for Nine Arches and Little Adam's Peak, then Mirissa for whales, turtles, and kayaking. End flexibly at Galle Fort, Madu River, and a beach stay or airport drop of your choice.

highlights.title: Wilpattu and Kaudulla safaris
highlights.description: Quieter lake-forest jeep days for leopards and elephants, then Cultural Triangle wildlife at Kaudulla.

highlights.title: Sigiriya, Pidurangala and Dambulla
highlights.description: Rock climbs and golden cave temples with village time around Habarana and Sigiriya.

highlights.title: Kandy, tea hills and Ella
highlights.description: Sacred temple culture, highland tea, Nine Arches, Little Adam’s Peak, and Ravana Falls.

highlights.title: Mirissa, turtles and Galle Fort
highlights.description: Whales or turtles, kayaking, then a south-coast close at Galle Fort and Madu River.

itinerary.title: Airport / Hotel – Wilpattu – Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Welcome to Sri Lanka. After pickup from the airport or your hotel, travel to Wilpattu National Park — the island’s largest and oldest wildlife sanctuary, famous for its natural lakes (villus). Enjoy a jeep safari with chances to spot leopards, elephants, sloth bears, deer, crocodiles, and rich birdlife in a peaceful, less-crowded park. Continue to Sigiriya for overnight.

images.alt: Wildlife safari in a Sri Lankan national park
images.title: Wilpattu safari

itinerary.title: Sigiriya & Habarana
itinerary.description: Experience Hiriwadunna village life near Habarana — a scenic walk past mud houses and paddy fields, a lake boat ride, and optional traditional cooking. Hike Pidurangala Rock for panoramic views of Sigiriya Fortress. Visit UNESCO Dambulla Cave Temple with ancient murals and Buddha statues, then unwind with Ayurveda at Athreya Spa in Sigiriya.
highlights: Habarana / Hiriwadunna village tour & boat ride

itinerary.title: Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Morning jeep safari at Kaudulla National Park for wild elephant herds around the reservoir, plus deer, monkeys, and birdlife. Then climb Sigiriya Lion Rock — UNESCO citadel with frescoes, the Mirror Wall, Lion’s Paw Terrace, and summit views over the ancient water gardens.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya – Kandy
itinerary.description: Travel toward the hill capital via Matale’s herbal and spice garden. In Kandy visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, enjoy a Kandyan cultural dance show at Kandy Lake Club, pause at Kandy Lake / viewpoint, and explore the Natural Gems and Gemmological Museum.
highlights: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic

images.alt: Cultural stops en route to Kandy
images.title: Kandy culture

itinerary.title: Kandy – Ella
itinerary.description: Climb into the highlands via Ambuluwawa Tower for 360° mountain views, stop at Ramboda Falls, and visit a tea centre/garden (Damro Labookellie / Blue Field) to see Ceylon tea production and taste a fresh cup before continuing to Ella.

images.alt: Tea plantations in Sri Lanka’s hill country
images.title: Tea country

itinerary.title: Ella
itinerary.description: A full Ella day: visit the iconic Nine Arches Bridge, hike Little Adam’s Peak for Ella Gap views, stop at Ravana Falls, and enjoy a scenic hill-country train ride through tea estates and misty mountains.

images.alt: Family at Nine Arch Bridge in Ella
images.title: Nine Arches Bridge

itinerary.title: Ella – Mirissa – Yala
itinerary.description: Descend to the south coast for Mirissa whale and dolphin watching, observe sea turtles at Turtle Beach, and enjoy an evening kayak safari toward Kamburugamuwa as the coastline turns golden. Overnight near Yala.

itinerary.title: Yala – Beach / Airport
itinerary.description: Flexible finale: explore Galle Dutch Fort, enjoy a Madu River mangrove boat safari in Balapitiya, and visit the Turtle Hatchery in Hikkaduwa. End with a beach stay of your choice (Hikkaduwa, Bentota, or Kalutara) or airport drop-off.
highlights: Beach stay or airport drop (your choice)

images.alt: Madu River style boat safari on the south-west coast
images.title: Madu River safari

faqs.question: Can I choose where Day 8 ends?
faqs.answer: Yes. After the south-coast stops you can continue to a beach hotel in Hikkaduwa, Bentota, or Kalutara, or go directly to the airport — whichever you prefer.

faqs.question: Is whale watching seasonal?
faqs.answer: Mirissa whale and dolphin watching is typically best from November to April. Outside peak season we suggest turtle watching, kayaking, or other coastal alternatives.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be customized?
faqs.answer: Yes. We tailor pace, hotels, and experiences to your preferences.
